picks.editorial_note: Purdue AI research projects were selected among the first cohort of the federal Genesis Mission AI awards, marking direct government investment in university-led AI research at national scale.
picks.title: Category: Research

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen's nationwide German permit to test its Level 4 autonomous vehicle on an open-source driving stack is a concrete regulatory milestone that could accelerate real-world autonomous vehicle deployment in Europe.
picks.title: RWTH Receives Nationwide Testing Permit for Autonomous Research Vehicle “karl.” | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: Princeton's finding that AI models misread basic police bodycam actions in roughly 1 in 4 cases raises serious concerns about deploying AI in high-stakes law enforcement accountability contexts.
picks.title: AI tools can miss the mark on police bodycam footage

picks.editorial_note: A prominent Helmholtz viewpoint arguing Europe must build sovereign open frontier AI models reflects a growing geopolitical debate over AI independence from US and Chinese model providers.
picks.title: Why we in Germany and Europe need to build our own open frontier models

picks.editorial_note: SRI International's use of mechanistic interpretability to make generative AI models more trustworthy addresses one of the field's most pressing safety challenges as models are deployed more widely.
picks.title: Responsible AI: Inside SRI's race to make generative models safe - SRI

picks.editorial_note: University of Toledo researchers built an AI tool that predicts osteoporosis risk years in advance using existing CT scans, a low-cost approach that could enable earlier intervention for a widely underdiagnosed condition.
picks.title: UToledo Researchers Develop AI Tool to Detect Osteoporosis Risk Using Existing CT Scans | UToledo News

picks.editorial_note: A $1.2M NSF grant brings USF, Purdue, and UT Dallas together to build quantum-resistant, AI-enabled security for next-generation wireless networks, addressing a critical infrastructure vulnerability as quantum computing advances.
picks.title: USF faculty secure $1.2M NSF grant to advance quantum-secure, AI-enabled wireless networks

picks.editorial_note: UAB spinout Spiromatics is commercializing AI-driven lung imaging biomarkers to improve diagnosis of COPD and other obstructive lung diseases, translating years of academic research into clinical practice.
picks.title: UAB startup brings decades of research to the future of lung care

picks.editorial_note: Three Aalto University researchers won highly competitive ERC Starting Grants, including funding for new mathematical foundations for safe reinforcement learning, a significant vote of confidence from Europe's top research funder.
picks.title: Three rising Aalto University researchers secure highly sought-after EU funding | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: Three Institut Polytechnique de Paris researchers secured ERC Starting Grants spanning generative AI and quantum computing, underscoring sustained European investment in frontier AI-adjacent research.
picks.title: Three IP Paris researchers awarded ERC Starting Grants
